rules: reference/n8n/** is read-only. Owned sources are consumed 1:1 through the pinned runtime artifact; nothing is rewritten.

owns.description: Schema & type validation (runtime shape checks, coercing field parsers, structural guards) plus the opt-in workflow rule engine agreed in ISSUE-003 Option A. Nothing else.

newCapability.reason: ISSUE-003 Option A — Validation is the only LEGO permitted to ENFORCE NodeUniqueness / DanglingConnections / CycleDetection; n8n 2.9.4 itself never rejects these at save time (golden A/B/C), so this is additive and opt-in (allowCycles defaults to true).

responsibilities: structural type guards (type-guards; 11 public, 2 package-internal, 1 used only internally)
zod runtime schemas mirroring interfaces.ts (schemas; 45 public)
workflow rule enforcement: DUPLICATE_NODE_NAME, DANGLING_CONNECTION, INVALID_CONNECTION_TYPE, CYCLE_DETECTED, INVALID_INPUT (rules)

items.reason: parameter-type validation is bound to node descriptions
graph traversal; Validation declares the acyclicity rule, Workflow does not enforce it (ISSUE-003)
